title: Drift scan document
description: Output of every per-repository drift scanner (scripts/drift_scan.py in timesheet-app, petclinic-microservices and timesheet-infra). The weekly drift report concatenates these documents, sorts by rank_score, and publishes the result as the remediation queue that a Track 2 fan-out consumes.

scanner.description: path of the scanner inside the scanned repository

advisory_coverage.description: set when the ecosystem has no advisory feed, so an empty advisories array is not read as 'no known vulnerabilities'

terraform_roots.description: timesheet-infra only: the Terraform roots that were scanned

errors.description: every failed lookup, unparseable manifest and degraded fallback. A non-empty array means the scan is incomplete and MUST be reported as such rather than treated as clean.

component.description: package name (npm), group:artifact (maven), provider/module source (terraform), or 'java'/'terraform' for a runtime

location.description: manifest or Terraform root the finding was read from, relative to the repository root

constraint.description: terraform only: the declared version constraint

constraint_allows_latest.description: terraform only: false means the constraint itself must be widened before the upgrade is possible

pinned_by_lockfile.description: terraform only: whether current came from .terraform.lock.hcl rather than from the constraint

exposure.description: how the component is reachable; feeds rank_score

advisories.description: highest severity first, truncated to --max-advisories; advisory_count keeps the untruncated total

rank_score.description: worst advisory severity + advisory volume + version staleness + exposure. Higher ranks first.

size.description: remediation effort: XS lockfile-only, S single manifest bump, M breaking major in one component, L high blast radius / cross-module
